topic: The hotel room sealed shut for 30 years after a guest vanished inside it
hook: A hotel room was sealed for 30 years after a guest vanished.
script: A hotel room was sealed for 30 years after a guest vanished. Room 1006 at the Skirvin Hotel in Oklahoma was locked after a woman allegedly jumped from the window. Staff reported hearing crying in the walls. Banging on the door from inside. The room sat empty for decades. When it finally reopened, guests reported figures at the foot of their beds. Follow for real haunting cases that defy explanation.
